  // Webflow native dropdown back button
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
    const dropdownWrappers = document.querySelectorAll("[data-dropdown-webflow='wrap']");

    // Loop through each dropdown wrapper
    dropdownWrappers.forEach(dropdownWrapper => {
      const backButtons = dropdownWrapper.querySelectorAll("[data-dropdown-webflow='back']");
      const dropdownContent = dropdownWrapper.querySelector("[data-dropdown-webflow='content']");
      const dropdownToggle = dropdownWrapper.querySelector("[data-dropdown-webflow='toggle']");

      // Loop through back buttons for this dropdown
      backButtons.forEach(backButton => {
        backButton.addEventListener("click", function () {
          if (dropdownContent.classList.contains("w--open") && dropdownToggle.classList.contains("w--open")) {
            // Trigger the Webflow 'w-close' event
            const event = new Event('w-close', { bubbles: true, cancelable: true });
            dropdownToggle.dispatchEvent(event);
            // Close the dropdown
            dropdownContent.classList.remove("w--open");
            dropdownToggle.classList.remove("w--open");
            dropdownToggle.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
            dropdownWrapper.style.zIndex = null;
          }
        });
      });
    });
  });
</script>
<script>
  // Height Adjustment
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
    const nav = document.querySelector('[data-nav]');
    const navMenu = nav.querySelector('[data-nav-offset]');
    const navButton = nav.querySelector('[data-nav-button]');
    const navDropdowns = nav.querySelectorAll('[data-dropdown-offset]');

    if (!nav || !navMenu || !navButton) return;

    const resetElementHeight = (element) => {
      if (element) element.style.removeProperty('height');
    };

    const adjustElementHeight = (element) => {
      if (!element || window.innerWidth >= 992) {
        resetElementHeight(element);
        return;
      }
      const navTopOffset = Math.max(0, nav.getBoundingClientRect().top);
      element.style.height = `calc(100dvh - ${navTopOffset}px)`;
    };

    const updateHeights = () => {
      if (window.innerWidth >= 992) {
        resetElementHeight(navMenu);
        navDropdowns.forEach(resetElementHeight);
        return;
      }
      adjustElementHeight(navMenu);
      navDropdowns.forEach(adjustElementHeight);
    };

    // --- debounce utility ---
    const debounce = (fn, delay = 100) => {
      let timeout;
      return (...args) => {
        clearTimeout(timeout);
        timeout = setTimeout(() => fn(...args), delay);
      };
    };

    const debouncedUpdate = debounce(updateHeights, 100);

    window.addEventListener('scroll', debouncedUpdate);
    window.addEventListener('resize', debouncedUpdate);

    // Re-run whenever navButton is clicked (open/close toggle)
    navButton.addEventListener('click', () => {
      setTimeout(updateHeights, 50); // small delay so Webflow can toggle classes
    });

    updateHeights(); // run once on load
  });
</script>

   * --- ORCHESTRATOR: Close any currently open dropdown ---
   * @param {boolean} force - If true, bypasses animations and resets state immediately.
   */
    const closeAllDropdowns = (force = false) => {
      if (force) {
        if (!currentlyOpenDropdown) return;
        const dropdownToClose = currentlyOpenDropdown;
        const contentToHide = dropdownToClose.querySelector("[data-dropdown='content']");
        const icon = dropdownToClose.querySelector("[data-dropdown='icon']");
        const contentCols = dropdownToClose.querySelectorAll("[data-dropdown-content='col']");
        const contentCTAs = dropdownToClose.querySelectorAll("[data-dropdown-content='cta']");

        gsap.killTweensOf([overlay, overlayFill, dropdownToClose.gsapTimeline, contentToHide, icon, contentCols, contentCTAs]);

        if (contentToHide) gsap.set(contentToHide, { display: "none", clearProps: "all" });
        if (icon) gsap.set(icon, { clearProps: "all" });
        if (contentCols.length > 0) gsap.set(contentCols, { clearProps: "all" });
        if (contentCTAs.length > 0) gsap.set(contentCTAs, { clearProps: "all" });

        dropdownToClose.setDropdownState(false);
        currentlyOpenDropdown = null;

        gsap.set(overlay, { display: "none", autoAlpha: 0 });
        gsap.set(overlayFill, { height: 0 });
        isAnimating = false;
        return;
      }

      if (!currentlyOpenDropdown || isAnimating) return;
      isAnimating = true;

      const dropdownToClose = currentlyOpenDropdown;

      const masterCloseTl = gsap.timeline({
        onComplete: () => {
          const contentToHide = dropdownToClose.querySelector("[data-dropdown='content']");
          if (contentToHide) {
            gsap.set(contentToHide, { display: "none" });
          }
          gsap.set(overlay, { display: "none", autoAlpha: 0 });
          gsap.set(overlayFill, { height: 0 });
          currentlyOpenDropdown = null;
          isAnimating = false;
        },
      });

      gsap.killTweensOf([overlay, overlayFill, dropdownToClose.gsapTimeline]);
      masterCloseTl.add(dropdownToClose.gsapTimeline.reverse());
      masterCloseTl.to(overlayFill, { 
        height: 0, 
        duration: DURATIONS.OVERLAY_FILL_CLOSE, 
        ease: "power2.inOut" 
      }, "-=0.3")
        .to(overlay, { 
        autoAlpha: 0, 
        duration: DURATIONS.OVERLAY_FADE_OUT, 
        ease: "power1.inOut" 
      }, "-=0.15");
      dropdownToClose.setDropdownState(false);
    };

    // --- ORCHESTRATOR: Open a specific dropdown ---
    
    const openDropdown = (dropdownWrap) => {
      if (isAnimating) return;
      isAnimating = true;

      const isSwitching = currentlyOpenDropdown !== null;
      if (isSwitching) {
        currentlyOpenDropdown.setLinksTabIndex("-1");
      }

      const content = dropdownWrap.querySelector("[data-dropdown='content']");
      content.style.display = "block";
      const contentHeight = content.offsetHeight;
      if (!isSwitching) content.style.display = "none";

      console.log('overlay:', overlay, 'overlayFill:', overlayFill, 'contentHeight:', contentHeight);

      const masterOpenTl = gsap.timeline({
        onComplete: () => {
          isAnimating = false;
        },
      });

      gsap.killTweensOf([overlay, overlayFill]);

      if (isSwitching) {
        const oldDropdown = currentlyOpenDropdown;
        const oldContent = oldDropdown.querySelector("[data-dropdown='content']");

        masterOpenTl
          .add(oldDropdown.gsapTimeline.reverse())
          .set(oldContent, { display: 'none' });

        masterOpenTl.to(overlayFill, { 
          height: contentHeight, 
          duration: DURATIONS.OVERLAY_FILL_SWITCH, 
          ease: "power2.inOut" 
        }, 0);

        masterOpenTl.add(dropdownWrap.gsapTimeline.restart(), DELAYS.SWITCH_CONTENT_START);

      } else {
        masterOpenTl.set(overlay, { display: "block" });
        masterOpenTl.to(overlayFill, { 
          height: contentHeight, 
          duration: DURATIONS.OVERLAY_FILL_OPEN, 
          ease: "power2.inOut" 
        }, 0);
        masterOpenTl.to(overlay, { 
          autoAlpha: 1, 
          duration: DURATIONS.OVERLAY_FADE_IN, 
          ease: "power1.inOut" 
        }, "<");
        masterOpenTl.add(dropdownWrap.gsapTimeline.restart(), `<${DELAYS.OPEN_CONTENT_START}`);
      }

      if (currentlyOpenDropdown) {
        currentlyOpenDropdown.setDropdownState(false);
      }

      dropdownWrap.setDropdownState(true);
      currentlyOpenDropdown = dropdownWrap;
    };

    // --- SETUP: Initialize each dropdown instance ---
    document.querySelectorAll("[data-dropdown='wrap']").forEach((dropdownWrap, dropdownIndex) => {
      if (dropdownWrap.dataset.scriptInitialized) return;
      dropdownWrap.dataset.scriptInitialized = "true";

      const toggle = dropdownWrap.querySelector("[data-dropdown='toggle']");
      const icon = dropdownWrap.querySelector("[data-dropdown='icon']");
      const close = dropdownWrap.querySelector("[data-dropdown='close']");
      const content = dropdownWrap.querySelector("[data-dropdown='content']");
      const contentCol = dropdownWrap.querySelectorAll("[data-dropdown-content='col']");
      const contentCTA = dropdownWrap.querySelectorAll("[data-dropdown-content='cta']");
      const contentHeader = dropdownWrap.querySelector("[data-dropdown-content='mobile-header']");

      if (!toggle || !content) return;

      const setupARIA = () => {
        const toggleId = `dropdown_toggle_${dropdownIndex}`;
        content.style.display = "none";
        toggle.id = toggleId;
        toggle.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
        toggle.setAttribute("aria-haspopup", "true");
        toggle.setAttribute("role", "button");
        toggle.setAttribute("tabindex", "0");
        content.setAttribute("id", `dropdown_content_${dropdownIndex}`);
        content.setAttribute("aria-labelledby", toggleId);
        // content.setAttribute("role", "menu");
        toggle.setAttribute("aria-controls", `dropdown_content_${dropdownIndex}`);
      };

      const setupLinks = () => {
        const links = content.querySelectorAll("a, button, [tabindex]");
        links.forEach(link => {
          // link.setAttribute("role", "menuitem");
          link.setAttribute("tabindex", "-1");
        });
        return links;
      };

      dropdownWrap.setLinksTabIndex = (tabIndex) => {
        const links = content.querySelectorAll("a, button, [tabindex]");
        links.forEach(link => link.setAttribute("tabindex", tabIndex));
      };

      dropdownWrap.setDropdownState = (isOpen) => {
        if (isOpen) {
          dropdownWrap.classList.add("cc-open-mode");
          toggle.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "true");
          dropdownWrap.setLinksTabIndex("0");
        } else {
          dropdownWrap.classList.remove("cc-open-mode");
          toggle.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
          dropdownWrap.setLinksTabIndex("-1");
        }
      };

      const focusFirstLink = () => {
        const links = content.querySelectorAll("a, button, [tabindex]");
        if (links[0]) links[0].focus();
      };

      const focusToggle = () => {
        toggle.focus();
      };

      setupARIA();
      const links = setupLinks();

      const createContentTimeline = () => {
        const tl = gsap.timeline({ paused: true });
        tl.set(content, { display: "block" });
        if (contentHeader) {
          tl.fromTo(contentHeader, 
                    { opacity: 0 }, 
                    { 
            opacity: 1, 
            duration: DURATIONS.CONTENT_ANIMATION, 
            ease: "power1.inOut" 
          }, 0);
        }
        if (contentCol.length > 0) {
          tl.fromTo(contentCol, 
                    { yPercent: -5, opacity: 0 }, 
                    { 
            yPercent: 0, 
            opacity: 1, 
            stagger: STAGGERS.CONTENT_COL, 
            duration: DURATIONS.CONTENT_ANIMATION, 
            ease: "power2.inOut" 
          }, 0);
        }
        if (contentCTA.length > 0) {
          tl.fromTo(contentCTA, 
                    { opacity: 0 }, 
                    { 
            opacity: 1, 
            stagger: STAGGERS.CONTENT_CTA, 
            duration: DURATIONS.CONTENT_CTA_ANIMATION, 
            ease: "power1.inOut" 
          }, `<${DELAYS.CONTENT_CTA_START}`);
        }
        if (icon) {
          tl.fromTo(icon, 
                    { rotate: 0 }, 
                    { 
            rotate: 180, 
            duration: DURATIONS.ICON_ROTATION, 
            ease: "power1.inOut" 
          }, "<");
        }
        return tl;
      };
      dropdownWrap.gsapTimeline = createContentTimeline();

      const toggleDropdown = () => {
        if (currentlyOpenDropdown === dropdownWrap) {
          closeAllDropdowns();
        } else {
          openDropdown(dropdownWrap);
        }
      };

      const handleToggleKeydown = (e) => {
        if (e.key === "Enter" || e.key === " ") { e.preventDefault(); toggleDropdown(); } 
        else if (e.key === "Escape") { closeAllDropdowns(); } 
        else if (e.key === "ArrowDown" && currentlyOpenDropdown === dropdownWrap) { e.preventDefault(); focusFirstLink(); }
      };

      const handleLinkKeydown = (index) => (e) => {
        if (e.key === "ArrowDown") { e.preventDefault(); (links[index + 1] || links[0]).focus(); } 
        else if (e.key === "ArrowUp") { e.preventDefault(); (links[index - 1] || links[links.length - 1]).focus(); } 
        else if (e.key === "Escape") { e.preventDefault(); closeAllDropdowns(); focusToggle(); } 
        else if (e.key === "Tab") {
          if ((!e.shiftKey && index === links.length - 1) || (e.shiftKey && index === 0)) { closeAllDropdowns(); }
        }
      };

      toggle.addEventListener("click", (e) => { e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); toggleDropdown(); });
      if (close) { close.addEventListener("click", (e) => { e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); closeAllDropdowns(); focusToggle(); }); }
      toggle.addEventListener("keydown", handleToggleKeydown);
      links.forEach((link, index) => { link.addEventListener("keydown", handleLinkKeydown(index)); });

      const handleOutsideClick = (e) => {
        if (e.target.closest("[data-dropdown='toggle']")) return;
        if (currentlyOpenDropdown && !currentlyOpenDropdown.contains(e.target)) { closeAllDropdowns(); }
      };
      document.addEventListener("click", handleOutsideClick);

      dropdownWrap.addEventListener("focusout", (e) => {
        if (e.relatedTarget && e.relatedTarget.closest("[data-dropdown='wrap']")) return;
        setTimeout(() => {
          if (currentlyOpenDropdown && !currentlyOpenDropdown.contains(document.activeElement)) {
            closeAllDropdowns();
          }
        }, 50);
      });
    });

    // --- Global Resize Handler ---
    window.addEventListener('resize', debounce(() => {
      const currentWidth = window.innerWidth;
      const currentHeight = window.innerHeight;
      const breakpoint = 992;

      if (currentWidth === lastWindowWidth && currentHeight === lastWindowHeight) return;

      const crossedBreakpoint = 
            (lastWindowWidth >= breakpoint && currentWidth < breakpoint) || 
            (lastWindowWidth < breakpoint && currentWidth >= breakpoint);

      if (crossedBreakpoint) {
        closeAllDropdowns(true);
      } else if (currentlyOpenDropdown && currentWidth >= breakpoint) {
        const content = currentlyOpenDropdown.querySelector("[data-dropdown='content']");
        if (content) {
          const newHeight = content.offsetHeight;
          gsap.to(overlayFill, { 
            height: newHeight, 
            duration: DURATIONS.RESIZE_ADJUSTMENT, 
            ease: "power1.inOut" 
          });
        }
      }

      lastWindowWidth = currentWidth;
      lastWindowHeight = currentHeight;
    }, 150));
  });

document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {

  /* ---------------------------------- */
  /* PERSONA SYNC                        */
  /* ---------------------------------- */

  const DEFAULT_PERSONA_SLUG = 'marketing';

  const PERSONA_LABEL_MAP = {
    marketing: 'Marketing teams',
    design: 'Design teams',
    engineering: 'Engineering teams',
    agencies: 'Agencies',
  };

  function personaSlugToLabel(slug) {
    if (!slug) return PERSONA_LABEL_MAP[DEFAULT_PERSONA_SLUG];
    return PERSONA_LABEL_MAP[slug] || PERSONA_LABEL_MAP[DEFAULT_PERSONA_SLUG];
  }

  function waitForPersonaReady(callback, attempts) {
    attempts = attempts || 0;

    if (window.PersonaSelect && typeof window.PersonaSelect.onReady === 'function') {
      window.PersonaSelect.onReady(function (instance) {
        callback(instance.getActiveOption() || DEFAULT_PERSONA_SLUG);
      });
      return;
    }

    if (attempts >= 40) {
      callback(DEFAULT_PERSONA_SLUG);
      return;
    }

    setTimeout(() => waitForPersonaReady(callback, attempts + 1), 100);
  }

  window.addEventListener('personaSelect:change', (e) => {
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('marqueePersona:change', { detail: { slug: e.detail.persona } }));
  });

  // NEW: bfcache restore handling. On a Back/Forward navigation served
  // from cache, DOMContentLoaded never re-fires, so PersonaSelect's
  // in-memory activeOption stays frozen at whatever it was before you
  // navigated away — even though localStorage (unaffected by freezing)
  // may have since changed on another page. Re-sync once here.
  window.addEventListener('pageshow', (e) => {
    if (!e.persisted) return;
    if (!window.PersonaSelect || typeof window.PersonaSelect.setActiveOption !== 'function') return;

    let freshSlug;
    try {
      freshSlug = localStorage.getItem('persona-select-active');
    } catch (err) {
      freshSlug = null;
    }

    window.PersonaSelect.setActiveOption(freshSlug || DEFAULT_PERSONA_SLUG);
  });

  /* ---------------------------------- */
  /* TAB VISIBILITY (global, once)       */
  /* ---------------------------------- */

  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => {
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('marqueeTabVisibility:change', {
      detail: { hidden: document.hidden },
    }));
  });

  /* ---------------------------------- */
  /* MARQUEE                             */
  /* ---------------------------------- */

  document.querySelectorAll('[data-marquee="component"]').forEach((marquee) => {
    if (marquee.dataset.scriptInitialized) return;
    marquee.dataset.scriptInitialized = 'true';

    let animation = null;
    let scrollTrigger = null;
    let intersectionObserver = null;
    let lastDuplicateAmount = null;
    let currentContentWidth = 0;

    const hoverPauseEnabled = marquee.dataset.marqueeHoverPause === 'true';
    const dragEnabled = marquee.dataset.marqueeDrag === 'true';

    let dialogPausedMarquee = false;
    let isHovered = false;
    let dragActive = false;
    let outOfView = false;
    let tabHidden = document.hidden;

    function syncPlayState() {
      if (!animation) return;
      const shouldPause =
        dialogPausedMarquee || dragActive || outOfView || tabHidden ||
        (hoverPauseEnabled && isHovered);

      if (shouldPause) {
        if (!animation.paused()) animation.pause();
        marquee.setAttribute('data-marquee-status', 'paused');
      } else {
        if (animation.paused()) animation.play();
        const currentTS = animation.timeScale();
        marquee.setAttribute('data-marquee-status', currentTS > 0 ? 'normal' : 'inverted');
      }
    }

    function getDuplicateAmount(componentWidth, contentWidth) {
      const rawDuplicateCount = (componentWidth * 2) / contentWidth;
      const minRequiredDuplicates =
        rawDuplicateCount % 1 <= 0.5 ? Math.floor(rawDuplicateCount) : Math.ceil(rawDuplicateCount);
      return Math.max(1, minRequiredDuplicates);
    }

    function stripClonedData(clone) {
      clone.querySelectorAll('[data-marquee-item="data"]').forEach((dataBlock) => dataBlock.remove());
    }

    function filterItemsByPersona(slug) {
      const label = personaSlugToLabel(slug);
      const masterTrack = marquee.querySelector('[data-marquee="track"]:not([data-marquee-clone="true"])');
      if (!masterTrack) return;

      masterTrack.querySelectorAll('[data-marquee="item"]').forEach((item) => {
        const itemPersona = item.getAttribute('data-marquee-persona');
        const matches = !label || !itemPersona || itemPersona === label;
        item.hidden = !matches;
      });
    }

    function buildMarquee() {
      marquee.setAttribute('data-marquee-status', 'loading');

      const preservedProgress = animation ? animation.progress() : 0.5;

      if (scrollTrigger) { scrollTrigger.kill(); scrollTrigger = null; }
      if (animation) { animation.kill(); animation = null; }

      const marqueeContent = marquee.querySelector('[data-marquee="track"]:not([data-marquee-clone="true"])');
      const marqueeScroll = marquee.querySelector('[data-marquee="wrap"]');
      if (!marqueeContent || !marqueeScroll) return;

      const { marqueeSpeed: speed, marqueeOnScroll: onScroll } = marquee.dataset;
      const marqueeSpeedAttr = parseFloat(speed) || 1;

      const contentWidth = marqueeContent.offsetWidth;
      const componentWidth = marquee.offsetWidth;
      currentContentWidth = contentWidth;

      const duplicateAmount = getDuplicateAmount(componentWidth, contentWidth);
      const marqueeSpeed = marqueeSpeedAttr * (contentWidth / componentWidth);

      marqueeScroll.querySelectorAll('[data-marquee-clone="true"]').forEach((clone) => clone.remove());

      const fragment = document.createDocumentFragment();
      for (let i = 0; i < duplicateAmount; i++) {
        const clone = marqueeContent.cloneNode(true);
        clone.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
        clone.setAttribute('data-marquee-clone', 'true');
        stripClonedData(clone);
        fragment.appendChild(clone);
      }
      marqueeScroll.appendChild(fragment);

      lastDuplicateAmount = duplicateAmount;

      const marqueeItems = marquee.querySelectorAll('[data-marquee="track"]');
      gsap.set(marqueeItems, { clearProps: 'all' });

      animation = gsap
        .fromTo(marqueeItems, { xPercent: 0 }, { xPercent: -100, repeat: -1, duration: marqueeSpeed, ease: 'linear' })
        .totalProgress(0.5);

      animation.progress(preservedProgress);
      animation.play();
      marquee.setAttribute('data-marquee-status', 'loaded');

      syncPlayState();

      if (onScroll === 'true') {
        scrollTrigger = ScrollTrigger.create({
          trigger: marquee,
          start: 'top bottom',
          end: 'bottom top',
          onUpdate: (self) => {
            const isScrollingDown = self.direction === 1;
            const currentDirection = isScrollingDown ? 1 : -1;
            const status = marquee.getAttribute('data-marquee-status');
            if (status !== 'paused') {
              animation.timeScale(currentDirection);
              marquee.setAttribute('data-marquee-status', isScrollingDown ? 'normal' : 'inverted');
            }
          },
        });
      }
    }

    if ('IntersectionObserver' in window) {
      intersectionObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
        entries.forEach((entry) => {
          outOfView = !entry.isIntersecting;
          syncPlayState();
        });
      }, { threshold: 0 });
      intersectionObserver.observe(marquee);
    }

    window.addEventListener('marqueeTabVisibility:change', (e) => {
      tabHidden = e.detail.hidden;
      syncPlayState();
    });

    marquee.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => { isHovered = true; syncPlayState(); });
    marquee.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => { isHovered = false; syncPlayState(); });

    /* ---- DRAG (progress-scrubbing) ---- */

    if (dragEnabled) {
      const dragWrap = marquee.querySelector('[data-marquee="wrap"]');

      if (dragWrap) {
        let dragStarted = false;
        let startX = 0, startY = 0, dragStartProgress = 0;
        let velocityTracker = [];
        let inertiaRafId = null;

        function normalizeProgress(p) {
          p = p % 1;
          if (p < 0) p += 1;
          return p;
        }

        function preventClickHandler(e) {
          e.preventDefault();
          e.stopPropagation();
          e.stopImmediatePropagation();
        }

        function calculateVelocity() {
          if (velocityTracker.length < 2) return 0;
          const recent = velocityTracker.slice(-5);
          let total = 0;
          for (let i = 1; i < recent.length; i++) {
            const dt = recent[i].time - recent[i - 1].time;
            if (dt > 0) total += ((recent[i].x - recent[i - 1].x) / dt) * 16;
          }
          return total / (recent.length - 1);
        }

        function runInertia(velocityPx) {
          let currentVelocity = velocityPx;
          const deceleration = 0.92;
          const threshold = 0.5;

          function step() {
            if (Math.abs(currentVelocity) < threshold) {
              dragActive = false;
              syncPlayState();
              return;
            }
            const deltaProgress = -currentVelocity / (currentContentWidth || 1);
            animation.progress(normalizeProgress(animation.progress() + deltaProgress));
            currentVelocity *= deceleration;
            inertiaRafId = requestAnimationFrame(step);
          }
          step();
        }

        function handlePointerDown(e) {
          if (dialogPausedMarquee || !animation) return;

          const clientX = e.type.includes('touch') ? e.touches[0].clientX : e.clientX;
          const clientY = e.type.includes('touch') ? e.touches[0].clientY : e.clientY;

          if (inertiaRafId) { cancelAnimationFrame(inertiaRafId); inertiaRafId = null; }

          dragStarted = true;
          startX = clientX;
          startY = clientY;
          dragStartProgress = animation.progress();
          velocityTracker = [{ x: clientX, time: Date.now() }];
        }

        function handlePointerMove(e) {
          if (!dragStarted) return;

          const clientX = e.type.includes('touch') ? e.touches[0].clientX : e.clientX;
          const clientY = e.type.includes('touch') ? e.touches[0].clientY : e.clientY;
          const deltaX = clientX - startX;
          const deltaY = clientY - startY;

          if (!dragActive) {
            if (Math.abs(deltaX) < 5 && Math.abs(deltaY) < 5) return;
            if (Math.abs(deltaY) > Math.abs(deltaX)) { dragStarted = false; return; }
            dragActive = true;
            dragWrap.style.cursor = 'grabbing';
            syncPlayState();
            marquee.querySelectorAll('[data-modal-trigger]').forEach((el) => {
              el.addEventListener('click', preventClickHandler, { capture: true });
            });
          }

          e.preventDefault();
          velocityTracker.push({ x: clientX, time: Date.now() });
          if (velocityTracker.length > 10) velocityTracker.shift();

          const deltaProgress = -deltaX / (currentContentWidth || 1);
          animation.progress(normalizeProgress(dragStartProgress + deltaProgress));
        }

        function handlePointerUp() {
          if (!dragStarted) return;
          dragStarted = false;
          dragWrap.style.cursor = 'grab';

          if (!dragActive) return;

          setTimeout(() => {
            marquee.querySelectorAll('[data-modal-trigger]').forEach((el) => {
              el.removeEventListener('click', preventClickHandler, { capture: true });
            });
          }, 50);

          const velocity = calculateVelocity();
          velocityTracker = [];

          if (Math.abs(velocity) > 1) {
            runInertia(velocity);
          } else {
            dragActive = false;
            syncPlayState();
          }
        }

        dragWrap.addEventListener('mousedown', handlePointerDown);
        dragWrap.addEventListener('touchstart', handlePointerDown, { passive: true });
        document.addEventListener('mousemove', handlePointerMove);
        document.addEventListener('touchmove', handlePointerMove, { passive: false });
        document.addEventListener('mouseup', handlePointerUp);
        document.addEventListener('touchend', handlePointerUp);

        dragWrap.addEventListener('contextmenu', (e) => e.preventDefault());
        dragWrap.addEventListener('dragstart', (e) => e.preventDefault());

        dragWrap.style.cursor = 'grab';
      }
    }

    /* ---- Init, persona, dialog, resize ---- */

    waitForPersonaReady((slug) => {
      filterItemsByPersona(slug);
      buildMarquee();
    });

    window.addEventListener('marqueePersona:change', (e) => {
      if (!animation) return;
      gsap.to(marquee, {
        opacity: 0,
        duration: 0.2,
        onComplete: () => {
          filterItemsByPersona(e.detail.slug);
          buildMarquee();
          gsap.to(marquee, { opacity: 1, duration: 0.2 });
        },
      });
    });

    window.addEventListener('modal-open', () => {
      dialogPausedMarquee = true;
      syncPlayState();
    });

    window.addEventListener('modal-close', () => {
      dialogPausedMarquee = false;
      syncPlayState();
    });

    let resizeTimer;
    window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
      clearTimeout(resizeTimer);
      resizeTimer = setTimeout(() => {
        const marqueeContent = marquee.querySelector('[data-marquee="track"]:not([data-marquee-clone="true"])');
        if (!marqueeContent) return;

        const contentWidth = marqueeContent.offsetWidth;
        const componentWidth = marquee.offsetWidth;
        const newDuplicateAmount = getDuplicateAmount(componentWidth, contentWidth);

        if (newDuplicateAmount !== lastDuplicateAmount) {
          gsap.to(marquee, {
            opacity: 0,
            duration: 0.2,
            onComplete: () => {
              buildMarquee();
              gsap.to(marquee, { opacity: 1, duration: 0.2 });
            },
          });
        }
      }, 500);
    }, { passive: true });
  });

  /* ---------------------------------- */
  /* MODAL                               */
  /* ---------------------------------- */

  const modalSystem = { list: {} };

  function findSourceForMarqueeId(marqueeId) {
    const candidates = document.querySelectorAll('[data-marquee-id="' + CSS.escape(marqueeId) + '"]');
    for (const candidate of candidates) {
      const data = candidate.querySelector('[data-marquee-item="data"]');
      if (data) return data;
    }
    return null;
  }

  function clearImage(modal) {
    const wrap = modal.querySelector('[data-modal-item="image-wrap"]');
    if (!wrap) return;
    wrap.querySelectorAll('img').forEach((img) => img.remove());
    wrap.hidden = true;
  }

  function populateImage(modal, source) {
    const wrap = modal.querySelector('[data-modal-item="image-wrap"]');
    if (!wrap) return;
    const field = source.querySelector('[data-marquee-item="image"]');
    const src = field?.getAttribute('src');
    if (!src) return;
    const img = document.createElement('img');
    img.className = 'u-img-cover';
    img.src = src;
    img.alt = field.getAttribute('alt') || '';
    wrap.appendChild(img);
    wrap.hidden = false;
  }

  function populateLinkField(modal, source, key) {
    const anchorTarget = modal.querySelector('[data-modal-item="' + key + '"]');
    const textTarget = modal.querySelector('[data-modal-item="' + key + '-text"]');

    const linkField = source.querySelector('[data-marquee-item="' + key + '"]');
    const textField = source.querySelector('[data-marquee-item="' + key + '-text"]');

    const text = textField?.textContent.trim();

    if (!text) {
      if (anchorTarget) {
        anchorTarget.hidden = true;
        anchorTarget.setAttribute('tabindex', '-1');
        anchorTarget.setAttribute('data-cta-text', '');
      }
      return false;
    }

    const href = linkField?.getAttribute('href');
    if (textTarget) textTarget.textContent = text;
    if (anchorTarget) {
      anchorTarget.href = href || '#';
      anchorTarget.hidden = false;
      anchorTarget.setAttribute('tabindex', '0');
      anchorTarget.setAttribute('data-cta-text', text);
    }
    return true;
  }

  function clearButtonCta(modal) {
    const wrap = modal.querySelector('[data-modal-item-wrap="button-cta"]');
    if (!wrap) return;
    wrap.hidden = true;
    const btnText = wrap.querySelector('.btn-text');
    const anchor = wrap.querySelector('a');
    const srOnly = wrap.querySelector('.u-sr-only');
    if (btnText) btnText.textContent = '';
    if (srOnly) srOnly.textContent = '';
    if (anchor) { anchor.href = '#'; anchor.setAttribute('data-cta-text', ''); }
  }

  function populateButtonCta(modal, source) {
    const wrap = modal.querySelector('[data-modal-item-wrap="button-cta"]');
    if (!wrap) return;
    const linkField = source.querySelector('[data-marquee-item="button-cta"]');
    const textField = source.querySelector('[data-marquee-item="button-cta-text"]');
    const text = textField?.textContent.trim();
    if (!text) return;
    const href = linkField?.getAttribute('href');
    const btnText = wrap.querySelector('.btn-text');
    const anchor = wrap.querySelector('a');
    const srOnly = wrap.querySelector('.u-sr-only');
    if (btnText) btnText.textContent = text;
    if (srOnly) srOnly.textContent = text;
    if (anchor) { anchor.href = href || '#'; anchor.setAttribute('data-cta-text', text); }
    wrap.hidden = false;
  }

  function clearModalContent(modal) {
    modal.querySelectorAll('[data-modal-item-wrap]').forEach((el) => {
      if (el.getAttribute('data-modal-item-wrap') === 'button-cta') return;
      el.hidden = true;
    });
    modal.querySelectorAll('[data-modal-item]').forEach((el) => {
      const key = el.getAttribute('data-modal-item');
      if (key === 'image-wrap') return;
      if (el.tagName === 'A') {
        el.href = '#';
        el.hidden = true;
        el.setAttribute('tabindex', '-1');
      }
      else { el.innerHTML = ''; }
    });
    clearImage(modal);
    clearButtonCta(modal);
  }

  function populateModal(modal, source) {
    if (!source) return;
    clearModalContent(modal);

    source.querySelectorAll('[data-marquee-item]').forEach((field) => {
      const key = field.getAttribute('data-marquee-item');
      const skip = [
        'item', 'image', 'button-cta', 'button-cta-text',
        'button-brd-1', 'button-brd-1-text',
        'button-brd-2', 'button-brd-2-text',
      ];
      if (skip.includes(key)) return;

      const targets = modal.querySelectorAll('[data-modal-item="' + key + '"]');
      if (!targets.length) return;

      let hasContent = false;
      targets.forEach((target) => {
        if (field.tagName === 'A') {
          const href = field.getAttribute('href');
          if (!href || href === '#') return;
          target.href = href;
          target.hidden = false;
          hasContent = true;
        } else {
          const html = field.innerHTML.trim();
          if (!html) return;
          target.innerHTML = html;
          hasContent = true;
        }
      });

      if (hasContent) {
        const wrap = modal.querySelector('[data-modal-item-wrap="' + key + '"]');
        if (wrap) wrap.hidden = false;
      }
    });

    populateLinkField(modal, source, 'button-brd-1');
    const brd2HasContent = populateLinkField(modal, source, 'button-brd-2');

    populateImage(modal, source);
    populateButtonCta(modal, source);

    const separator = modal.querySelector('[data-modal-item-wrap="brd-separator"]');
    if (separator) separator.hidden = !brd2HasContent;
  }

  document.querySelectorAll("[data-modal-target]").forEach(function (modal) {
    if (modal.dataset.scriptInitialized) return;
    modal.dataset.scriptInitialized = "true";

    if (modal.parentElement !== document.body) {
      document.body.appendChild(modal);
    }

    const modalId = modal.getAttribute("data-modal-target");
    const modalBackdrop = modal.querySelector("[data-modal-backdrop]");
    const modalContent = modal.querySelector("[data-modal-content]");
    let lastFocusedElement;

    if (typeof gsap !== "undefined") {
      gsap.context(() => {
        let tl = gsap.timeline({ paused: true, onReverseComplete: resetModal });
        tl.fromTo(modalBackdrop, { opacity: 0 }, { opacity: 1, duration: 0.3, ease: "power1.out" });
        tl.from(modalContent, { opacity: 0, y: "3rem", duration: 0.3, ease: "power1.out" }, "<");
        modal.tl = tl;
      }, modal);
    }

    function resetModal() {
      typeof lenis !== "undefined" && lenis.start ? lenis.start() : (document.body.style.overflow = "");
      modal.close();
      clearModalContent(modal);
      if (lastFocusedElement) lastFocusedElement.focus();
      window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("modal-close", { detail: { modal } }));
    }

    function openModal() {
      typeof lenis !== "undefined" && lenis.stop ? lenis.stop() : (document.body.style.overflow = "hidden");
      lastFocusedElement = document.activeElement;
      modal.showModal();
      if (typeof gsap !== "undefined") modal.tl.play();
      modal.querySelectorAll("[data-modal-scroll]").forEach((el) => (el.scrollTop = 0));
      window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("modal-open", { detail: { modal } }));
    }

    function closeModal() {
      typeof gsap !== "undefined" ? modal.tl.reverse() : resetModal();
    }

    modal.addEventListener("cancel", (e) => (e.preventDefault(), closeModal()));
    modal.addEventListener("click", (e) => e.target.closest("[data-modal-close]") && closeModal());

    document.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
      const trigger = e.target.closest("[data-modal-trigger='" + modalId + "']");
      if (!trigger) return;
      const clickedItem = trigger.closest("[data-marquee-id]");
      if (!clickedItem) return;
      const marqueeId = clickedItem.getAttribute('data-marquee-id');
      const source = findSourceForMarqueeId(marqueeId);
      populateModal(modal, source);
      openModal();
    });

    modalSystem.list[modalId] = {
      open: (marqueeId) => (populateModal(modal, findSourceForMarqueeId(marqueeId)), openModal()),
      close: closeModal,
    };
  });

          return;

        let videoId, thumbnailUrl, embedUrl, html, type;

          // YouTube
          const match = videoUrl.match(/(?:v=|youtu\.be\/)([^&]+)/);
          if (!match) {

            return;
          }
          videoId = match[1];
          thumbnailUrl = `https://i.ytimg.com/vi/${videoId}/hqdefault.jpg`;

          const match = videoUrl.match(/vimeo\.com\/(?:video\/|groups\/[^/]+\/videos\/)?(\d+)/);

            return;
          }
          videoId = match[1];
          thumbnailUrl = `https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/${videoId}_640.jpg`; // fallback, not always accurate

        } else {

            originalUrl: videoUrl,
            width: 940,
            height: type === 'video' && embedUrl.includes('vimeo') ? 529 : 528,
            thumbnailUrl,
            html,
            type

          group: ""

          jsonScript.textContent = JSON.stringify(videoData);
        }
      });

      component.dataset.scriptInitialized = "true";

      const swiperElement = component.querySelector(".slider_element");
      const swiperWrapper = component.querySelector(".slider_list");
      if (!swiperElement || !swiperWrapper) return;
      function removeCMSList(slot) {
        const dynList = Array.from(slot.children).find((child) => child.classList.contains("w-dyn-list"));
        if (!dynList) return;
        const nestedItems = dynList?.firstElementChild?.children;
        if (!nestedItems) return;
        const staticWrapper = [...slot.children];
        [...nestedItems].forEach(el => el.firstElementChild && slot.appendChild(el.firstElementChild));
        staticWrapper.forEach((el) => el.remove());
      }
      removeCMSList(swiperWrapper);

      [...swiperWrapper.children].forEach((el) => el.classList.add("swiper-slide"));

      // Create media query listener for dynamic updates
      const reducedMotionQuery = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');
      let prefersReducedMotion = reducedMotionQuery.matches;
      reducedMotionQuery.addEventListener('change', (e) => {
        prefersReducedMotion = e.matches;
      });
      const followFinger = swiperElement.getAttribute("data-follow-finger") === "true",
            freeMode = swiperElement.getAttribute("data-free-mode") === "true",
            mousewheel = swiperElement.getAttribute("data-mousewheel") === "true",
            slideToClickedSlide = swiperElement.getAttribute("data-slide-to-clicked") === "true",
            speed = prefersReducedMotion ? 0 : 750;

      new Swiper(swiperElement, {
        a11y: {
          slideRole: "listitem"
        },
        slidesPerView: "auto",
        followFinger: followFinger,
        freeMode: freeMode,
        slideToClickedSlide: slideToClickedSlide,
        centeredSlides: false,
        autoHeight: false,
        speed: speed,
        //cssMode: true, // helps iOS content flicker, but messes up overflow :(
        mousewheel: {

        },
        keyboard: {

          prevEl: component.querySelector("[data-slider='previous']"),
        },
        slideActiveClass: "is-active",
      });
    });

  function initMarketoScript() {

    // Your public reCAPTCHA v3 site key
    window.recaptchaSiteKey = '6LdEZD8jAAAAAFnhphir8s8mupFMI-IZZJbGt-pp';

    // Helper: wait for MktoForms2 before using it
    function waitForMkto(cb) {
      if (window.MktoForms2 && typeof MktoForms2.whenReady === 'function') {
        cb();
      } else {
        setTimeout(function () {
          waitForMkto(cb);
        }, 50);
      }
    }

    function initializeMarketoForms() {
      var formElements = document.querySelectorAll('form[data-formid]');
      var formIds = Array.from(
        new Set(
          Array.from(formElements).map(function (form) {
            return parseInt(form.getAttribute('data-formid'), 10);
          }),
        ),
      );

      var mktoFormConfig = {
        podId: '//go.webflow.com',
        munchkinId: '050-LKC-745',
        formIds: formIds,
      };

      function mktoFormChain(config) {
        if (!config || !config.formIds || !config.formIds.length) {
          console.error('Invalid form configuration');
          return;
        }

        var arrayify = getSelection.call.bind([].slice);
        var MKTOFORM_ID_ATTRNAME = 'data-formid';

        MktoForms2.whenRendered(function (form) {
          var formEl = form.getFormElem()[0];
          var rando = '_' + new Date().getTime() + Math.random();

          arrayify(formEl.querySelectorAll('label[for]')).forEach(function (labelEl) {
            var forEl = formEl.querySelector('[id="' + labelEl.htmlFor + '"]');
            if (forEl) {
              labelEl.htmlFor = forEl.id = forEl.id + rando;
            }
          });
        });

        arrayify(config.formIds).forEach(function (formId) {
          var loadForm = MktoForms2.loadForm.bind(MktoForms2, config.podId, config.munchkinId, formId);
          var formEls = arrayify(document.querySelectorAll('[' + MKTOFORM_ID_ATTRNAME + '="' + formId + '"]'));

          if (!formEls.length) {
            console.warn('No form elements found with ' + MKTOFORM_ID_ATTRNAME + '="' + formId + '"');
            return;
          }

          (function loadFormCb(queue) {
            var hostEl = queue.shift();
            if (!hostEl) return;

            hostEl.id = 'mktoForm_' + formId;
            loadForm(function (form) {
              hostEl.id = '';
              if (queue.length) loadFormCb(queue);
            });
          })(formEls);
        });
      }

      mktoFormChain(mktoFormConfig);
    }

    // Ensure DOM + jQuery are ready before touching the DOM
    jQuery(function () {
      // Wait for MktoForms2 before any Marketo-specific calls
      waitForMkto(function () {
        initializeMarketoForms();

        /* --- reCAPTCHA v3 client-side support --- */
        (function () {
          var userConfig = {

              grecaptcha.ready(function () {
                grecaptcha
                  .execute(userConfig.apiKeys.recaptcha, {
                    action: userConfig.actions.formSubmit,
                  })
                  .then(function (recaptchaFinger) {
                    var mktoFields = {};

                      mktoForm.locked = true;
                      mktoFields[userConfig.fields.recaptchaFinger] = userConfig.debug.testBadFinger ? 'known bad fingerprint ' + Math.random() : recaptchaFinger;
                      mktoForm.addHiddenFields(mktoFields);
                      mktoForm.submittable(true);
                      mktoForm.submit();
                    }
                  });
              });
            });
          });

          var recaptchaListeners = {
            ready: function () {
              MktoForms2.whenReady(function (mktoForm) {
                var formEl = mktoForm.getFormElem()[0];
                var submitButtonEl = formEl.querySelector("button[type='submit']");
                if (submitButtonEl) submitButtonEl.disabled = false;
              });

          };
          Object.keys(recaptchaListeners).forEach(function (fnName) {
            window['grecaptchaListeners_' + fnName] = recaptchaListeners[fnName];
          });

          // Inject the reCAPTCHA library
          var recaptchaLib = document.createElement('script');
          recaptchaLib.src = 'https://www.google.com/recaptcha/api.js?render=' + userConfig.apiKeys.recaptcha + '&onload=grecaptchaListeners_ready';
          document.head.appendChild(recaptchaLib);
        })();

        /* --- Branded Marketo Form Styling --- */
        MktoForms2.whenReady(function () {
          $("input[type='hidden']").parent('.mktoFormRow').css('display', 'none');
          $('textarea').closest('.mktoFormRow').addClass('full-width');
          $("input[type='checkbox']").closest('.mktoFormRow').addClass('full-width');

          $('.mktoForm').each(function () {
            $(this).find('.mktoFormRow.terms').appendTo($(this));
          });
        });
      });
    });
  }

  // Update footer year
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    const elements = document.querySelectorAll('[data-footer-year]');
    elements.forEach(element => {
      element.textContent = new Date().getFullYear();
    });
  });

  // Webflow Logo Hover effect
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
    if (window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches) {
      return;
    }

    if (typeof gsap === "undefined") {
      return;
    }

    const footerBrands = document.querySelectorAll(".g-footer-brand");

    footerBrands.forEach((footerBrand) => {
      const logoContainer = footerBrand.querySelector(
        ".g-brand-logo_img-container"
      );
      const logoImages = footerBrand.querySelectorAll(".g-brand-logo_img");

      // Check if we have the necessary elements
      if (!logoContainer) return;
      if (logoImages.length <= 1) return;

      // Set initial state - all logos invisible except first
      gsap.set(logoImages, { opacity: 0 });
      gsap.set(logoImages[0], { opacity: 1 });

      // Create timeline for infinite loop
      const tl = gsap.timeline({
        repeat: -1,
        paused: true,
      });

      // Create gif-like effect - each image shows for a brief moment
      logoImages.forEach((logo, index) => {
        tl.to(logoImages, {
          opacity: 0,
          duration: 0.05,
        })
          .to(
          logo,
          {
            opacity: 1,
            duration: 0.05,
          },
          "-=0.05"
        )
          .to({}, { duration: 0.15 });
      });

      // Mouse tracking variables
      let isHovering = false;
      let lastMousePosition = { x: 0, y: 0 };
      let mouseMoveTimeout;

      function pauseAnimation() {
        tl.pause();
      }

      function resumeAnimation() {
        if (isHovering) {
          tl.play();
        }
      }

      // Mouse enter/leave events
      footerBrand.addEventListener("mouseenter", (e) => {
        isHovering = true;
        lastMousePosition.x = e.clientX;
        lastMousePosition.y = e.clientY;
        resumeAnimation();
      });

      footerBrand.addEventListener("mouseleave", () => {
        isHovering = false;
        pauseAnimation();

        // Reset GIF to first image
        gsap.set(logoImages, { opacity: 0 });
        gsap.set(logoImages[0], { opacity: 1 });

        // 2. Reset the parallax effect smoothly
        gsap.to(logoContainer, {
          xPercent: 0,
          yPercent: 0,
          duration: 0.3,
          ease: "power1.out",
        });

        if (mouseMoveTimeout) {
          clearTimeout(mouseMoveTimeout);
        }
      });

      // Mouse move event
      footerBrand.addEventListener("mousemove", (e) => {
        if (!isHovering) return;

        const currentX = e.clientX;
        const currentY = e.clientY;

        // 3. ADD PARALLAX LOGIC
        const rect = footerBrand.getBoundingClientRect();
        // Calculate cursor position from -1 (left/top) to +1 (right/bottom) relative to the element's center
        const x = (currentX - rect.left - rect.width / 2) / (rect.width / 2);
        const y = (currentY - rect.top - rect.height / 2) / (rect.height / 2);

        // Animate the container. Max move is 15% in any direction.
        gsap.to(logoContainer, {
          xPercent: x * 7,
          yPercent: y * 7,
          duration: 0.5,
          ease: "power1.out",
        });

        // Check if mouse actually moved (for GIF animation logic)
        const moved =
              Math.abs(currentX - lastMousePosition.x) > 1 ||
              Math.abs(currentY - lastMousePosition.y) > 1;

        if (moved) {
          lastMousePosition.x = currentX;
          lastMousePosition.y = currentY;

          resumeAnimation();

          if (mouseMoveTimeout) {
            clearTimeout(mouseMoveTimeout);
          }

          mouseMoveTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
            pauseAnimation();
          }, 500);
        }
      });
    });
  });

    wf_utils.getUser((user) => {
      const isLoggedIn = user ? 'true' : 'false';
      const scope = 'user'; // or 'pageview'
      const attributes = { loggedIn: isLoggedIn };

      wf.setAttributes(scope, attributes);
    });
  });
  // User device type (mac, pc, etc.)
  wf.ready(() => {
    const userAgent = navigator.userAgent.toLowerCase();
    let deviceType = 'Other';

    if (userAgent.includes('mac')) deviceType = 'Mac';
    else if (userAgent.includes('windows')) deviceType = 'Windows';
    else if (userAgent.includes('linux')) deviceType = 'Linux';
    else if (userAgent.includes('android')) deviceType = 'Android';
    else if (userAgent.includes('iphone') || userAgent.includes('ipad')) deviceType = 'iOS';

    const scope = 'user'; // or 'pageview'
    const attributes = { userAgent: deviceType };

    wf.setAttributes(scope, attributes);
  });
</script>

<script>
  function disableBackdropBlurOnSafari() {
    const isSafari = /^((?!chrome|crios|fxios).)*safari/i.test(navigator.userAgent);

    if (isSafari) {
      const elementsToFix = document.querySelectorAll('[data-blur-safari]');
      elementsToFix.forEach((element) => {
        element.style.backdropFilter = 'none';
        element.style.webkitBackdropFilter = 'none';
      });
    }
  }

  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
    disableBackdropBlurOnSafari();

      if (!host || !host.shadowRoot) return false;
      if (host.shadowRoot.querySelector('#webster-position-override')) return true;

      const style = document.createElement('style');
      style.id = 'webster-position-override';
      style.textContent = `
        @media (min-width: 768px) {
          [role="region"][aria-label="Converse with Webster, AI Agent"]:has([part="chat"][data-hidden="true"]) {

      host.shadowRoot.appendChild(style);
      return true;

      if (injectWebsterStyles()) clearInterval(interval);

review.reviewBody: With Webflow, we're not just keeping up, we're setting the pace. It's the speedboat that's helping us move faster than ever before.
With Webflow, we've significantly improved organic traffic, SEO, and conversions. From my perspective as CMO, that's a huge win because our brand is reaching more people.
Designers can bypass the traditional design-to-developer handoff and make updates directly. Writers can also edit content themselves, making the process more efficient for everyone.
We're saving upwards of $6 million a year with Webflow, and we've reinvested those savings in other areas like website optimization and localization.
Webflow empowers us to do what we do best as marketers, designers, and content creators: It strips away the technical complexity and unleashes us to be creative, try new things, and iterate quickly.

Webflow doesn't just allow you to work faster and easier, but differently. Speed is huge, but once you get engineers, designers, and copywriters to really enjoy working together, that's something different.

hasPart.name: Webflow is the agentic web marketing platform for high-performing brands
hasPart.description: AI has raised the stakes: Now brand websites need to resonate with humans, rank in AI search, and drive measurable revenue. Webflow is the platform modern teams choose to build sites that do it all.

hasPart.name: Build together
hasPart.description: Bring team members and AI agents into one shared workspace, with design systems to keep everything on brand.

hasPart.name: Publish at scale
hasPart.description: Create and manage content in a visual, composable CMS — with built-in SEO and AEO to reach humans and machines alike.

hasPart.name: Optimize for growth
hasPart.description: Turn every page into a revenue driver with native analytics and AI that show you what's working and help you scale it.

hasPart.name: Design without limits
hasPart.description: Design directly in the browser — no redlines, no translation layer. What you design is what ships, pixel for pixel.

hasPart.name: Build your design system, live
hasPart.description: Build reusable components, variables, and styles that scale across your entire site and keep your entire team on brand.

hasPart.name: Publish without the handoff tax
hasPart.description: Take your designs all the way to production without waiting on a developer to interpret your files.

hasPart.name: Build without the bottleneck
hasPart.description: Give marketers the power to iterate without pinging your team — while you stay in control of the codebase, components, and structure.

hasPart.name: Ship with clean, semantic code
hasPart.description: Every element you build in Webflow outputs clean HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. No lock-in, no spaghetti markup, no surprises at handoff.

hasPart.name: Integrate everything
hasPart.description: Connect to your stack with a flexible API, webhooks, and logic. Webflow fits into how you already work — not the other way around.

hasPart.name: Build once, deploy everywhere
hasPart.description: Bring your whole team — designers, developers, and strategists — into one shared workspace, with design systems that keep every client site on brand at scale.

hasPart.name: Hand off sites clients can actually manage
hasPart.description: Build on Webflow's visual CMS and your clients can manage their own content without touching the design or breaking the layout.

hasPart.name: Turn every project into recurring revenue
hasPart.description: Native analytics, A/B testing, and AI-powered optimization built right in — so you can show clients results and grow retainers.

hasPart.name: 300,000+ brands move the needle with Webflow
hasPart.description: From startups to Fortune 500s — including The New York Times, Dropbox, Monday.com, TED, Docusign, IDEO, and BBDO — over 300,000 companies trust Webflow to power their web presence.

Webflow Enterprise gives marketing teams the flexibility, security, and reliability they need to scale innovative web experiences that drive growth in the age of AI.

Webflow Enterprise gives creative teams the flexibility, security, and reliability to scale brand-forward experiences in the age of AI — without compromising consistency or creative vision.

Webflow Enterprise gives engineering teams the control, scalability, and reliability they need to reduce non-core dev work — so they can focus on delivering business-critical value in the age of AI.

Webflow Enterprise gives agencies the flexibility, control, and scalability they need to deliver high-impact work for the most complex clients.

Move quickly without sacrificing quality or process

Launch on-brand experiences fast. Webflow Enterprise delivers the marketing speed you need with the precision you demand. Built-in guardrails protect quality, while structured processes ensure speed without added risk.

Turn traffic into revenue

Launch sophisticated web experiments seamlessly with native, AI-powered optimization tools. Webflow Enterprise helps ensure your digital experiences are both SEO/AEO-friendly and optimized for conversion — so you can drive real business results.

Reduce overhead with a single source of truth

Collaborate more effectively by uniting creative, marketing, and dev teams in one platform. With Webflow Enterprise, every team can move faster, together — making scalable web experiences possible and reducing the total cost of ownership.

Create quickly without sacrificing quality or process

Visually build expressive, high-impact designs without adding to the engineering backlog. Your team can build independently and produce at scale, with the systems and approvals that ensure brand integrity is upheld even as campaigns multiply.

Deliver on-brand design that drives results

In Webflow Enterprise, creative work ships fast and contributes to performance. With testing and optimization tools built into the same platform where design happens, creative teams play an active role in improving outcomes. What’s normally a heavy, cross-functional lift becomes seamless, even at scale.

Cut overhead for consistent, scalable design

Streamline creative collaboration by bringing creative, marketing, and dev teams together in one platform. With a shared workspace, integrated React components, and a centralized design system, design-to-development happens automatically — making handoffs seamless and eliminating tool sprawl.

Don’t compromise on speed, quality, or control

Enable marketing speed without compromising developer control. Structured components and built-in governance let marketing ship independently without touching your backlog, while code quality and system performance remain protected.

Connect content and data at enterprise scale

Webflow Enterprise unifies content, localization, and optimization in a single governed system. With robust APIs and seamless integrations into your tech stack, marketing can iterate and personalize at scale — without dev lift or performance trade-offs.

Consolidate infrastructure, cut overhead

Replace fragmented CMS, hosting, and deployment pipelines with one scalable platform. By reducing tool sprawl and maintenance burden, engineering teams spend less time on upkeep and more time focusing on high-value dev work.

Move quickly without sacrificing quality or process

Visually build expressive, high-impact designs without adding to the engineering backlog. Your team can build independently and produce at scale, with the systems and approvals that ensure brand integrity is upheld even as campaigns multiply.

Streamline client handoffs

Streamline creative collaboration by bringing agency and client teams together in one platform. With a shared workspace, integrated React components, and a centralized design system, design-to-development happens automatically — making handoffs seamless and eliminating tool sprawl.

Offer clients more than just design

Unify content, localization, and optimization in a single platform. With robust APIs and seamless integrations, Webflow fits into any client’s tech stack and empowers them to iterate and personalize at scale — without dev lift or performance trade-offs.

Webflow Enterprise helps big brands meet their web needs today — and tomorrow.

Frequently asked questions

Along with everything included in standard plans, Enterprise plans provide the scale, collaboration tools, security, and support that large organizations need, including:

  • Higher bandwidth, flexible pricing, and pooled product usage across teams
  • Page branching, publishing workflows, and custom roles for complex collaboration
  • SSO, SCIM, and SOC 2 Type II compliance for enterprise IT requirements
  • A dedicated CSM, onboarding support, and Enterprise SLAs

Webflow Enterprise meets strict enterprise security requirements with SOC 2 Type II certification, SSO integration, and automated user provisioning via SCIM and JIT. 

Sites are protected by AWS- and Cloudflare-powered DDoS mitigation, TLS/SSL traffic encryption, and optional custom SSL certificates and security headers. An audit log API lets you pipe key events — like login activity and role changes — into your SIEM tools, and a Site Activity log tracks all site changes.

Yes. Webflow Enterprise supports native integrations directly in the Designer so marketers can easily connect existing tools — like HubSpot, Marketo, and Google Analytics — without engineering support. 

For deeper customization, Webflow's robust, MACH-aligned API platform lets engineering teams build custom integrations, automations, and enterprise workflows.

Webflow Enterprise plans include a dedicated Customer Success Manager, tailored onboarding through Webflow University Pro, and access to technical consulting with Webflow Solutions Architects for more complex needs.

Enterprise customers also get priority support through a dedicated queue, and can engage Certified Webflow Partners for additional expertise. Click here to learn more about how Webflow supports Enterprise teams.

Webflow Enterprise is hosted on AWS and delivered through Cloudflare's global CDN, with automatic traffic scaling, sub-50ms global reach, and 99.99% uptime SLAs. And built-in performance features like global caching, automatic image optimization, and DDoS protection keep sites fast even during traffic spikes. 

For teams, the Webflow platform supports multiple sites within a single Workspace, plus features like shared design system libraries, page branching, custom roles, and publishing workflows to maintain quality at scale.

Enterprise customers like Fivetran (130+ pages launched in a year) and Nursa (~40,000 pages migrated in 19 days) show what's possible at scale with Webflow.

Frequently asked questions What’s the difference between Webflow Enterprise and standard Webflow plans? Along with everything included in standard plans, Enterprise plans provide the scale, collaboration tools, security, and support that large organizations need , including: Higher bandwidth, flexible pricing, and pooled product usage across teams Page branching, publishing workflows, and custom roles for complex collaboration SSO, SCIM, and SOC 2 Type II compliance for enterprise IT requirements A dedicated CSM, onboarding support, and Enterprise SLAs How does Webflow Enterprise handle security and compliance for large organizations? Webflow Enterprise meets strict enterprise security requirements with SOC 2 Type II certification, SSO integration, and automated user provisioning via SCIM and JIT. Sites are protected by AWS- and Cloudflare-powered DDoS mitigation, TLS/SSL traffic encryption, and optional custom SSL certificates and security headers. An audit log API lets you pipe key events — like login activity and role changes — into your SIEM tools, and a Site Activity log tracks all site changes. Can Webflow Enterprise integrate with our existing enterprise tools and custom APIs? Yes. Webflow Enterprise supports native integrations directly in the Designer so marketers can easily connect existing tools — like HubSpot, Marketo, and Google Analytics — without engineering support. For deeper customization, Webflow's robust, MACH-aligned API platform lets engineering teams build custom integrations, automations, and enterprise workflows. What kind of dedicated support does Webflow Enterprise provide? Webflow Enterprise plans include a dedicated Customer Success Manager, tailored onboarding through Webflow University Pro, and access to technical consulting with Webflow Solutions Architects for more complex needs. Enterprise customers also get priority support through a dedicated queue, and can engage Certified Webflow Partners for additional expertise. Click here to learn more about how Webflow supports Enterprise teams. How scalable is Webflow Enterprise for high-traffic sites and multiple teams? Webflow Enterprise is hosted on AWS and delivered through Cloudflare's global CDN, with automatic traffic scaling, sub-50ms global reach, and 99.99% uptime SLAs. And built-in performance features like global caching, automatic image optimization, and DDoS protection keep sites fast even during traffic spikes. For teams, the Webflow platform supports multiple sites within a single Workspace, plus features like shared design system libraries, page branching, custom roles, and publishing workflows to maintain quality at scale. Enterprise customers like Fivetran (130+ pages launched in a year) and Nursa (~40,000 pages migrated in 19 days) show what's possible at scale with Webflow. Workspace and Site plans

Every site built in Webflow automatically lives inside of a Workspace.

When you sign up for Webflow, you get a free Workspace plan by default. A Workspace is a space where you stage sites — and where you can invite teammates and clients to work on sites together. Upgrading your Workspace plan gives you access to enhanced staging capabilities and advanced collaboration features.

Site plans give you the tools to build your site. When you sign up for Webflow, you automatically get a free Starter Site plan. When you need to publish, host, or unlock additional site-building features, you can upgrade that specific site to a paid Site plan.

Workspaces are designed to be a space for you to organize and build your sites, and invite people to build with you. You may have different needs for different Workspaces, so you can create as many as you need, but each Webflow customer is limited to one free Workspace.

Any Workspace tier can support an unlimited number of paid Site plans. The main difference in site limits on Workspace tiers is the number of Starter sites each tier supports (Free = 2; Core = 10; Growth = Unlimited). As soon as you upgrade a Starter site to a paid Site plan, it no longer counts against your free Starter site limit.

Yes, but you’ll still pay the remainder of the term for the plan you signed up for.

A Platform plan bundles a site, Workspace, add-ons, and more to help growing teams and enterprise organizations get started faster with Webflow.

Frequently asked questions Workspace and Site plans What’s the difference between a Workspace and a Site plan? Every site built in Webflow automatically lives inside of a Workspace. When you sign up for Webflow, you get a free Workspace plan by default. A Workspace is a space where you stage sites — and where you can invite teammates and clients to work on sites together. Upgrading your Workspace plan gives you access to enhanced staging capabilities and advanced collaboration features. Site plans give you the tools to build your site. When you sign up for Webflow, you automatically get a free Starter Site plan. When you need to publish, host, or unlock additional site-building features, you can upgrade that specific site to a paid Site plan. How many Workspaces can I have? Workspaces are designed to be a space for you to organize and build your sites, and invite people to build with you. You may have different needs for different Workspaces, so you can create as many as you need, but each Webflow customer is limited to one free Workspace. How many paid Site plans can I have in my Workspace? Any Workspace tier can support an unlimited number of paid Site plans. The main difference in site limits on Workspace tiers is the number of Starter sites each tier supports (Free = 2; Core = 10; Growth = Unlimited). As soon as you upgrade a Starter site to a paid Site plan, it no longer counts against your free Starter site limit. Can I cancel my Site and/or Workspace at any time? Yes, but you’ll still pay the remainder of the term for the plan you signed up for. What is a Platform plan? A Platform plan bundles a site, Workspace, add-ons, and more to help growing teams and enterprise organizations get started faster with Webflow. What Premium plan add-ons are available? We provide customer support via email and aim to reply to all requests within 48 hours. You can also find guides and solutions in the Webflow Help Center , courses and tutorials on Webflow University , and a host of helpful Webflow customers in the Webflow Community . Can I host my website somewhere else? You can export your site and host it anywhere you like with any of our paid Workspace plans, no attribution required. ‍ Note: Dynamic content must be exported on a collection-by-collection basis and forms will stop working. Can my clients or coworkers upload their own content? For Starter, Freelancer, and Agency Workspace plans, clients can use client seats to publish new content anytime. How much traffic can Webflow hosting handle? Webflow hosting scales automatically to handle millions of simultaneous visits and uses Cloudflare's CDN to load websites in milliseconds. How does Webflow Cloud pricing work? Webflow Cloud provides built-in storage for web apps. Apps can be created and deployed without a Webflow site using the app project type, or added to an existing Webflow site to extend its functionality. Usage follows Webflow’s existing site plan structure, with limits for bandwidth, requests, CPU usage, and storage. Paid plans include surge protection to handle temporary traffic spikes, and additional capacity can be added as usage grows. Can I import my website or my code? No, you can only develop websites in Webflow. If you export your code, it can’t be reimported. Are Webflow websites SEO-friendly? Yes, Webflow sites are SEO-friendly. Our blazing-fast hosting, standards-based code, free SSL, and mobile-friendliness all help Webflow sites rank in search. Does Webflow have an API? Webflow’s REST API allows you to add, update, and remove items from your CMS. Read the documentation . How much does a Webflow Certification exam cost? The Webflow Practitioner Certification exam is $100 USD. In some countries and regions, additional taxes (such as VAT) may apply. Need help?
